economic_hypothesis.mechanism: Discrete unlocks create newly transferable supply. Larger scheduled releases relative to recent causal spot absorption capacity should be associated with weaker event-window returns.

event_construction.input: ONLY route-qualified SOURCE_DATA_FEASIBLE events from the frozen source-gate receipt
event_construction.composite_event_date: UTC calendar date of the constituent scheduled timestamps
event_construction.composite_anchor_timestamp: earliest constituent scheduled timestamp on that UTC date

causal_signal_calibration.volume_window: 30 completed UTC daily bars immediately preceding entry_day; entry_day and all later rows forbidden in calibration
causal_signal_calibration.volume_source: Binance Spot official historical archives, SYMBOLUSDT, base-asset Volume
causal_signal_calibration.unlock_pressure_days: composite_scheduled_unlock_tokens / mean(base_asset_volume over frozen 30 completed pre-entry UTC days)
causal_signal_calibration.high_pressure_threshold_rule: 67th percentile of unlock_pressure_days over the final causal-signal-resolved Discovery composite-event set

discovery_execution_semantics.entry: sell/stand aside at SYMBOLUSDT daily open 00:00Z on UTC_DATE(EVENT)-7 days
discovery_execution_semantics.exit: re-enter at SYMBOLUSDT daily open 00:00Z on UTC_DATE(EVENT)+8 days
discovery_execution_semantics.window_interpretation: single fixed 15-calendar-day open-to-open avoidance window covering anticipation and post-release absorption
discovery_execution_semantics.overlapping_high_pressure_windows_same_t: UNION into one continuous avoidance episode for economic PnL; transact once at first entry and once at final exit
discovery_execution_semantics.event_level_mechanism_observations: remain event-level; dependence handled by token-cluster inference

market_data.source: Binance Spot official historical Data Vision archives
market_data.integrity: CHECKSUM required for every archive used
market_data.archive_absence_rule: fail closed for affected event/episode; no substitute venue
market_data.late_2024_event_rule: exclude if any required signal, entry, exit or benchmark row would require 2025 data; do not truncate the window

cost_model.base_interpretation: 10 bps spot fee plus 5 bps execution/slippage allowance per side
cost_model.stress_interpretation: 10 bps fee plus 20 bps execution/slippage allowance per side

inference.primary_mechanism_pass: beta < 0 and two-sided 95% confidence interval upper bound < 0
inference.supporting_rank_test: Spearman(unlock_pressure_days, btc_adjusted_log_return) expected negative; reported but not sufficient alone

promotion_gate_all_required: primary mechanism regression beta is negative with 95% CI upper bound below zero
high-pressure mean BASE net avoidance return > 0
high-pressure mean STRESS net avoidance return > 0
token-cluster bootstrap 95% lower bound of high-pressure STRESS mean net avoidance return > 0
token-cluster bootstrap 95% upper bound of high-pressure mean BTC-adjusted log return < 0
2023 high-pressure BASE mean net avoidance return >= 0
2024 high-pressure BASE mean net avoidance return >= 0
largest single token share of high-pressure event observations <= 0.35

discovery_classification.NO_EDGE: sample/data gates pass but one or more statistical/economic promotion gates fail
discovery_classification.DATA_FAILURE: required official archives or checksum integrity fail after frozen availability rules
discovery_classification.TECHNICAL_FAILURE: implementation failure before a scientific verdict

protected_period.2025: LOCKED; may be opened only after SURVIVES_DISCOVERY and separate explicit protocol authorization

hard_prohibitions: no threshold change after forward outcomes
